summary.text: An Nsukka-area LGA on the border with Benue, made up of two towns: Enugu-Ezike, the headquarters, and Ette. Igbo is the main language; Ette is multilingual.

peoples.name: Ette (Etteh)
peoples.note: Egenti (2015) finds Idoma their strongest language, then Igala, then Igbo. See the Idoma and Igala profiles.

languageUse.text: The Ette speak three languages: Idoma, Igala and Igbo, with Idoma used most. Elsewhere in the LGA Igbo is the main language.
